description: Search everything the room can read — the campaign's canon and drafts, the craft and world skills, and this project's own files. Hybrid: it matches on words and on meaning at once, so both 'brine permit' and 'how does a family here talk about money' work. Returns the passage, the file it came from and its heading, so you can read_artifact the file for more.

query.description: what you want to know, in your own words

scope.description: optional: 'references', 'skills', or 'project' for this project's files

kind.description: optional: canon, guide, draft or room

_why: The library is larger than any prompt. This is how an agent reaches the rest of it without carrying it, and how it finds a fact it was never given.
